description: DCA, deep count autoencoder (Eraslan et al. 2019, last commit 2022-07, pinned to keras<2.6 / tf<2.5) must run under Python 3.11 / TensorFlow>=2.16 (Keras 3) / NumPy>=2 / pandas>=2 / current scanpy+anndata. Uses removed APIs: keras.engine.topology, keras.objectives, tf.compat.v1 sessions.
